dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome back, <name>{{name}}</name>. Here is what needs you today.

chips.noRate: No rate on file — an expense in any currency but USD is refused until one exists. Add one

needsAttention.title: Needs attention
needsAttention.cannotRaise_one: Nobody can raise it until a chain is published.
needsAttention.cannotRaise_other: Nobody can raise them until a chain is published.
needsAttention.resetArmed: System reset is ARMED — the whole database can be wiped from Settings. Disarm it

leaveNotice.short: Short notice — {{given}} days given, {{preferred}} preferred for this leave type.

leaveDiscretionary.label: Grant as discretionary — do not deduct from the balance
leaveDiscretionary.hintOff: The approved days come out of the balance when the request is fully approved.
leaveDiscretionary.hintOn: Nothing is deducted: the {{type}} balance stays at {{balance}}. Every approver can set this, and the final approver's choice is the one that takes effect.
leaveDiscretionary.outcome: Discretionary — nothing was deducted, so the {{type}} balance is still {{balance}}.
leaveDiscretionary.panelNote: Granted at the approver's discretion — nothing was deducted, and nothing will be.
leaveDiscretionary.noteRequiredLabel: required — why the days are not deducted
leaveDiscretionary.noteRequiredError: Say why these days are not being deducted.
leaveDiscretionary.noteRequiredHint: Required: nothing comes out of the balance, so the record has to say why it was granted.

tiers.minTierHelp: Applies to this tier and more senior (smaller numbers).

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Everything you are part of, in any capacity.
requests.help: “To handle” is everything waiting for your signature right now. “Mine” is everything you raised or that was raised for you. “Involved” is every other request you are attached to. The filters below reshape the list; the tab badge always shows the true total.

filters.datesNote: Dates filter completed requests. Anything still open always shows.

empty.handle: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
empty.handleHint: That is the normal state — a card appears here when someone needs your signature.
empty.mine: You have not raised any requests yet.

card.delegateConfirmHint: They will be able to sign it in your place. You can take it back until they do.

new.nothingRaisable: There is nothing you can raise yet.
new.nothingRaisableHint: A request type needs an approval chain published before anyone can raise it.
new.notLinked: Your account is not linked to an employee record.
new.notLinkedHint: So you cannot raise requests. Ask an administrator to link it.
new.onBehalf: Raising on behalf of another employee.
new.defaultsToYou: Defaults to you. You may raise on behalf of another employee.
new.titlePlaceholder: Filled in from what you enter above
new.listedAs: This request will be listed as:
new.listedAsEmpty: Fill in the details above to see the title.
new.step1Skipped: Step 1 will be skipped — you cannot approve your own request.
new.noFormYet: This request type has no form yet.
new.noFormYetHint: It is configured, but the screen to raise it is still to come.
new.chooseToBegin: Choose a request type to begin.
new.pageSubtitle: Raise a request and see who has to sign it.
new.pageHelp: Pick the kind of request, then fill it in. Each type follows a fixed approval chain, shown on its card and again before you submit.

step.skippedNoReason: Skipped by the workflow — no reason was recorded.
step.delegateConfirmHint: They will be able to sign it in your place. You can take it back until they do.

settlement.title: Final settlement
settlement.notPrepared: Not prepared — the final sign-off is blocked until the figures are entered.
settlement.noShortfall: None — notice was served in full
settlement.shortfallHint: Notice was {{days}} short. Record any pay in lieu as notice pay below.
settlement.totalFormula: Leave, indemnity, notice pay and other dues, less deductions. The stored figure is the one the server computes from what you save.
settlement.saved: Settlement saved. The final sign-off is no longer blocked.
settlement.currencyRequired: Choose the currency this settlement is paid in.
settlement.closedUnprepared: This request closed without a settlement being prepared.

cancel.title: Cancel this request?
cancel.reasonHint: The request is cancelled, not deleted — the reason stays in its history.
cancel.done: Request cancelled. The reason is on its history.

retract.signExplain: Undoing a signed decision must itself be signed with your password.
retract.done: Decision withdrawn. Step {{step}} is waiting for a fresh decision.

email.queued: Queued to {{address}} — sends within a minute

exitPermission.convertOn: These hours come out of the employee’s annual leave balance.
exitPermission.convertOff: These hours are handled as a pay matter, not deducted from leave.
exitPermission.missingOrder: a return time after the leaving time
exitPermission.errorOrder: The return time must be after the leaving time.

leave.relationCapNote: {{type}} is capped per relation, so this sets how many days may be asked for.
leave.certificateBody: Submit this, then attach it on the request page — it cannot be approved until a document is attached.
leave.overCap: {{type}} allows up to {{days}} for a {{relation}}. Shorten the dates, or this will be refused.
leave.overBalance: That is more than the {{type}} balance of {{days}}. The request will be refused unless the company allows a negative balance.
leave.noticeShortWithPreferred: This was raised at short notice — sooner than the {{count}} days’ notice this leave type prefers, so your approver may ask about it.
leave.noticeShort: This was raised at short notice — sooner than preferred, so your approver may ask about it.
leave.halfHint: Half a day of the balance. The other half of the shift is worked and measured as usual.
leave.costNothing: — working days only: of the {{calendar}} calendar day(s), {{rest}} rest day(s) and {{holidays}} public holiday(s) cost nothing.
leave.noWorkingDay: These dates contain no working day for this employee — only rest days and public holidays.

tip.duplicateCurrency: {{currency}} appears twice — one row per currency.
tip.noEmployees: No active employees at this branch.
tip.includingRaiser: Everyone who worked the shift at {{branch}} — including whoever is raising this.
tip.missingAmount: at least one amount above zero
tip.missingDuplicate: one row per currency ({{currency}} appears twice)
tip.noticeNoAttendance: No attendance record found that day for: {{names}}. The operations manager should confirm they worked the shift.

overtime.restDay: Rest day — the whole worked time counts as overtime.
overtime.rateNote: {{duration}} at 150% of the hourly wage — an upper limit; payroll pays the actual extra time worked, up to it.
overtime.missingCap: a figure of {{max}} minutes or less
overtime.noticeUnrostered: That day has no rostered shift — every worked minute will count as overtime, up to the approved cap.

shiftSwap.counterpartRequired: Choose who you are swapping with
shiftSwap.noCounterpart: Nobody else holds this role ({{role}}). Swaps are between employees in the same role — pick a different employee above, or check Positions in HR.
shiftSwap.noShift: No shift rostered that day — the swap will be refused.
shiftSwap.agreed: The counterpart has agreed to this swap
shiftSwap.agreedHint: The record stores who asserted this; the operations manager verifies it.
shiftSwap.noticeShortNotice: Less than 48 hours before the first shift — short notice for the roster.

expense.thresholdNonUsd: The owner threshold is applied on the USD equivalent, using the latest stored rate.
expense.thresholdAbove: Above the {{threshold}} USD threshold — the Owner will also sign, unless the operations manager grants {{threshold}} or less.
expense.thresholdUnder: At or under {{threshold}} USD — the operations manager approves alone.
expense.receiptNote: A receipt is required: attach it on the request page after submitting — approval is refused without one.
expense.noticeOwner: {{amount}} USD equivalent — above the {{threshold}} USD threshold, so expect the Owner to sign as well unless less is granted. Remember the receipt.
expense.noticeReceipt: Remember to attach the receipt — approval is refused without it.

availability.startsHint: This changes the weekly pattern from that date. Days already on the roster keep their shifts — the operations manager fixes those by hand.
availability.loadPattern: Choose the employee to load their current pattern.
availability.reasonPlaceholder: Why the schedule needs to change
availability.missingWorkingDay: at least one working day (a whole week off is leave, not availability)
availability.noticeConflicts: {{count}} day(s) already on the roster contradict this change. They keep their shifts until someone edits the roster.

onboarding.candidatePlaceholder: Full name, as it appears on the ID
onboarding.notEmployeeYet: They are not an employee yet — the employee record is created when the hire is approved.
onboarding.registrationNote: Registration numbers can be filled in later — the checklist on the request page tracks them, and the last approval is refused while a required item is outstanding.
onboarding.noticeChecklist: {{count}} onboarding items are now on the checklist, on this request’s page.

separation.shortfall: {{count}} days short of the required notice. This does not block the request — notice may be paid in lieu, and the settlement records it.
separation.leaveLedger: Leave still on the ledger: {{days}} days
separation.leaveLedgerTail: . The settlement is prepared on the request page.
separation.noIndemnity: No basic salary on file, so no provisional indemnity can be offered — the preparer enters every figure.
separation.noticeShortfall: {{count}} days short of the {{required}}-day notice period — record any pay in lieu in the settlement.
separation.noticeRecorded: {{kind}} recorded. Prepare the settlement on this request’s page; the Owner cannot sign off until it exists.

payrollAdjustment.deduction: A deduction — this amount comes OFF the payslip.
payrollAdjustment.earning: An earning — this amount is ADDED to the payslip.
payrollAdjustment.landsInHint: The open period whose payslip will carry this line.
payrollAdjustment.correctsRunHint: Only locked runs appear — a correction references history. Leave empty for a one-off.
payrollAdjustment.reasonPlaceholder: What was wrong, and why this fixes it
payrollAdjustment.missingAmount: a positive amount (the component decides direction)
payrollAdjustment.missingReason: the reason — an unexplained adjustment is indistinguishable from an error
payrollAdjustment.notice: Once approved, the correction lands in {{period}} — regenerate that run to pick it up.

salaryAdvance.monthlyDeductionRequired: How much comes off each month?
salaryAdvance.monthlyHint: Taken from each payslip until the advance is repaid.
salaryAdvance.firstDeductedHint: Recovery starts here — it must be a month payroll has not locked.
salaryAdvance.missingDeductionSize: a monthly deduction no larger than the advance
salaryAdvance.notice: Once approved, recovery starts in {{period}} — the ledger row is created at the Owner’s signature.

rosterApproval.monthHint: The whole month’s roster for this branch goes up for signature as one request.
rosterApproval.covers: Covers every rostered day at {{branch}} in {{month}}.

state.draft: {{month}} has not been submitted for approval.

hint.draft: Finish the month first — a roster sent up with gaps in it is sent up twice.
hint.pending: A request is open on it. Changes made now are changes nobody has signed for.
hint.approved: Signed off. Anything changed after this differs from what was approved.
hint.pendingRequest: {{month}} is with its approvers. The grid is read-only until they decide — withdraw the request to edit it now.
hint.changed: {{month}} was signed off, and the roster has moved since. What is on the grid now is not what was approved until it is submitted again.

blocked.approvedUnchanged: Approved and unchanged since — nothing new to submit

rosterApproval.clearConfirm: Every shift assignment for {{branch}} in {{month}} is removed, and the month starts again as an empty draft. A month that is waiting for approval, approved, or already has attendance recorded on it is refused by the server.
rosterApproval.readOnly: Read-only while request #{{id}} waits for approval.
rosterApproval.approvedToast: Roster for {{month}} approved — {{branch}}. It is now the active roster.
rosterApproval.activatedByYou: Roster approved. It is now the month's active roster — attendance is measured against it.

attendance.dayFractionTitle: {{percent}}% of a full day was earned
attendance.anomalyTitle: The machine could not read this day confidently — usually a missing punch-out. Open the day to see why.

anomalyText.neverOut: Punched in at {{time}}, never punched out.
anomalyText.neverIn: Punched out at {{time}}, but never punched in.
anomalyText.none: No punches at all on a day that was rostered.
anomalyText.unpaired: Punches at {{in}} and {{out}} could not be paired into a worked interval.
anomalyText.leftOver: The ins and outs do not match up — {{count}} complete interval(s) were found, but some punches were left over.

anomalies.title: Anomalies
anomalies.subtitle: Late arrivals, early departures and missing punches, for HR to decide.
anomalies.help: A punch at or beyond the tolerance (the shift's grace, else the Attendance tolerance setting) is not an error — it is a question for HR. Until it is decided the minutes stay covered in pay, and payroll will not run for the month while any are undecided. Excuse keeps the minutes paid, Deduct takes them off the day, Correct time enters the punch as it should have been.
anomalies.blockNote: Undecided anomalies block payroll — the month cannot be paid while any are left. A decision applies immediately; a corrected time goes on the day as a manual entry.

actions.missingOnlyCorrect: A missing punch can only be corrected

toolbar.nothingToDecide: No undecided late arrivals or early departures in what is shown

bulk.scope: {{month}}{{branch}} — {{count}} undecided late arrival(s) / early departure(s) shown.
bulk.skipped_one: {{count}} missing punch is skipped — it needs its own corrected time.
bulk.skipped_other: {{count}} missing punches are skipped — each needs its own corrected time.
bulk.excuseEffect: Every one keeps its minutes covered: the day is paid in full.
bulk.deductEffect: Every one loses its minutes: they come off the day, and the day fraction drops.
bulk.notePlaceholder: One note stored on every decision, e.g. ‘Month-end ruling, agreed with operations.’

dialog.excuseEffect: The {{minutes}} stay covered. The day is paid in full and stops blocking payroll.
dialog.deductEffect: The {{minutes}} come off the day. The day fraction drops accordingly and the day stops blocking payroll.
dialog.correctEffectIn: Enter the time they actually arrived. It is stored as the In punch through the manual path (the original punch is kept), the day is re-derived, and this anomaly is closed for good.
dialog.correctEffectOut: Enter the time they actually left. It is stored as the Out punch through the manual path (the original punch is kept), the day is re-derived, and this anomaly is closed for good.
dialog.correctedTimeHint: Must fall on the work date. Overnight shifts may end the next morning.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Why you decided it this way. Somebody will ask.
dialog.reDecide: Changing an earlier ruling of {{decision}}. A corrected time cannot be changed afterwards.

saved.Corrected: {{name}}, {{date}}: time corrected. The day now shows {{worked}} worked.

empty.undecidedText: Every late arrival, early departure and missing punch in this month{{branch}} has been decided, so nothing here is blocking payroll. Switch the decision filter to ‘All’ to see the rulings already made.
empty.allText: No punch in this month{{branch}} fell outside the tolerance and none is missing. If you expected one, check the month above — a day is only listed once its punches have been processed.

home.title: Attendance
home.subtitle: Whether this month is safe to hand to payroll, and what is still open if it is not.
home.help: Payroll reads attendance. If attendance is incomplete, pay is wrong. This page lists everything still open for the month. Clear every one and the month is safe to pay.
home.notReady_one: {{period}} is NOT ready — {{count}} thing to fix
home.notReady_other: {{period}} is NOT ready — {{count}} things to fix
home.readySub: Every punch is processed, attributed, readable and settled. Payroll can read this month safely.
home.notReadySub: Payroll reads attendance as it stands. Anything left open below is paid wrong, quietly. Open each one and clear it.
home.overtimeNote: Overtime here is detected, not payable — it is what the punches show, not what anyone authorised. Pay only what an approved overtime request covers.
home.noneRecorded: No attendance has been recorded for {{period}} yet.
home.noneRecordedHint: Import the device file, then run the processor on the Daily Attendance page. Until then there is nothing for payroll to read.
home.noMatch: No employee matches the filters. Clear them to see the month again.

blockers.unprocessedPunchesHint: Punches nobody has processed. The days they belong to are missing entirely.
blockers.unresolvedPinPunchesHint: Punches on a PIN nobody is enrolled on. That person’s days are missing.
blockers.openAnomaliesHint: Days the machine could not read confidently. The hours on them are not trustworthy.
blockers.pendingCorrectionsHint: Figures that are about to change. Paying now pays the old ones.
blockers.rosteredDaysWithNoRecordHint: Rostered days that produced no record at all — nothing to pay or deduct against.
blockers.undecidedExitVariancesHint: Nobody has said whether the extra time is unpaid, offset, or ignored.
blockers.undecidedAnomaliesHint: Late arrivals, early departures and missing punches nobody has excused, deducted or corrected. Until then payroll does not know what the day is worth.

grid.daysWorkedTitle: Fractional. Someone who left two hours early counts 0.75 of a day, not 1.
grid.overtimeDetectedTitle: Detected from the punches. Attendance never pays this on its own.
grid.unpaidAbsenceDaysTitle: Absences not covered by approved leave. This is the deduction.
grid.exitLeaveDaysTitle: Time out during the day, converted to days off the leave balance.

daily.reprocessTitle: Rebuild {{date}} from its punches under the current punch-direction settings. The punches themselves are not changed, and a day corrected by hand stays corrected.
daily.absenteesTitle: Write an Absent day for everybody rostered on {{date}} who never punched. Run the processor first, so the people who did punch already have their day.
daily.buildHint: All three act on the day above, except Run processor — that one takes every unprocessed punch, whatever day it belongs to. Run it first: it turns punches into days, so it only ever sees days that HAVE punches. Marking absentees afterwards is what writes a day for the people who were rostered and never punched.
daily.punchesHint: Every punch recorded on {{date}}, exactly as the machine sent it — before the processor turns it into hours. Updates by itself as machines are read.
daily.noPunchesHint: If somebody did punch, the machine has not been read yet — pull it from Attendance → Devices, or check that machine's last pull.
daily.printTitle: Open the printable daily sheet for {{date}} and this branch.

pairs.expand: Show the punch pairs behind this day
pairs.gapTitle: Time clocked OUT before the next pair opens. The break, and then any mid-day exit, come out of this — it is not worked time.
pairs.none: No complete pairs on this day — every punch is still waiting for a partner.

unrostered.help: Days someone punched although the approved roster for that month gives them no row. Nothing is paid or deducted for such a day. Add the day to the roster — the next reprocess derives it — or leave it if the punches were not work.
unrostered.emptyText: Every punch of the month falls on a day its approved roster knows about.

quarantine.help: Punches that arrived under a device PIN enrolled to nobody. They are kept, not dropped. Map the PIN to its employee: the waiting punches become theirs and every day they fall on is derived again. Days already paid stay as paid — raise a payroll adjustment for those.
quarantine.emptyText: Every punch the terminals sent belongs to an enrolled employee.
quarantine.mapBody: {{count}} punch(es) from {{device}} are waiting under this PIN. The employee chosen here is enrolled with it, receives them, and their days are derived again.
quarantine.pickEmployee: Choose the employee this PIN belongs to.
quarantine.result: PIN {{pin}} is now {{employee}}: {{punches}} punch(es) resolved, {{days}} day(s) derived again.
quarantine.resultPaid: {{count}} day(s) are already paid and were left as paid — raise a payroll adjustment for them.

adjustments.confirm: This creates one adjustment per active employee.
adjustments.reasonHint: It appears on every payslip line this creates.
adjustments.branchHint: Leave as all branches unless this is meant for one of them.
adjustments.branchUnreadable: The branch list is not readable with your permissions, so this can only be given to every branch.
adjustments.givenNoneHint: Everyone in scope already has this component for this period with this reason.

tiers.title: Tiers & ceilings
tiers.subtitle: The rate tables payroll computes from — income tax brackets, and the NSSF schemes with their salary ceilings.
tiers.help: Nothing here recomputes a payslip. A run already generated keeps the figures it was generated with; these tables decide what the NEXT run computes. NSSF rates are versioned rather than edited, so an old month re-runs to what it produced at the time.
tiers.taxHint: Each bracket taxes the slice of ANNUAL income between its floor and its ceiling. The top bracket is left open — it applies to everything above the last floor.
tiers.nssfHint: Employee and employer contribution rates, and the salary above which each scheme stops contributing. Rates change by decree — use New version rather than editing, so months already paid still explain themselves.
tiers.fallbackHint: Used for ceilinged schemes that have no ceiling of their own.
tiers.fallbackMissing: The fallback ceiling is not readable here.
tiers.fallbackMissingHint: NssfCeilingUsd is a system setting, and reading it needs SETTING_MANAGE. Schemes with their own ceiling are unaffected; ask an administrator to set the fallback.
tiers.ceilingHint: Leave empty for the top bracket — it then applies to everything above the floor.
tiers.effectiveToHint: Leave empty while the bracket is still in force.
tiers.ceilingAmountHint: This scheme's own ceiling. Leave empty to use the default below — which is what every scheme did before per-scheme ceilings existed.
tiers.fallbackTitle: This scheme has no ceiling of its own, so the default below applies.
tiers.newVersionTitle: Create a new dated version of this scheme, prefilled from it. The existing row is left untouched.
tiers.newVersionHint: This creates a NEW row. Set the date it takes effect from — the existing version stays exactly as it is, so months already paid still explain themselves.
tiers.deleteBody: The {{currency}} bracket from {{floor}} to {{ceiling}} will be removed.
tiers.deleteHint: Payslips already generated are not changed — they keep the figures they were generated with. This only affects what the next run computes.
tiers.warnOverlap: {{scope}}: income from {{from}} to {{to}} falls in two brackets at once.
tiers.warnGap: {{scope}}: income from {{from}} to {{to}} falls in no bracket at all.
tiers.warnManyOpen: {{scope}}: {{count}} brackets are left open-ended. Only the top one should be.
tiers.warnOpenNotLast: {{scope}}: the open-ended bracket at {{floor}} is not the highest one, so the brackets above it can never apply.
tiers.errRate: A rate must be between 0 and 100%.
tiers.errCeiling: The ceiling must be above the floor, or empty for the top bracket.
tiers.errCeilingAmount: A ceiling must be more than zero. Leave it empty to use the default.
tiers.bandHint: What a basic salary may be at each rank. Enforced on every salary-component write, so a basic outside its tier band is refused when it is saved.
tiers.bandBlankHint: Leave a box blank for no bound on that side. Blank on both sides removes the band entirely.

access.deniedHint: You don't have permission to view this page. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.forbiddenAction: You don't have permission for this action

roles.rejectionEndsHint: Off = the rejection is recorded as advice and the request continues

exchangeRates.deleteHint: Anything already converted at this rate keeps the figure it was converted with. Only conversions made from now on change.
exchangeRates.pairLocked: The pair and the type cannot be changed — correct the figure or the date, or add a new rate.

employee.emailHint: Where the system sends the notice when one of their requests is approved or rejected. Leave empty and none is sent.
employee.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
employee.preferredLanguageHint: The language this person is written to in. Notifications about their requests are composed in it — it does not change the language they see when they sign in.
employee.phoneInvalid: Enter a Lebanese phone number: 8 digits (e.g. 03 123 456) or +961 followed by the number.
employee.contactRequired: Phone number and e-mail are required for a new employee.
employee.phoneHint: 8 digits (03 123 456) or +961 followed by the number. Stored as +961…
employee.noContactHint: No phone / e-mail — notifications cannot reach this employee.
employee.transferHint: This is a transfer out of {{from}}. Days before this date stay under {{from}} in rosters, attendance and payroll. A future date is recorded now and applied on that day.

employeeForm.managerCleared: That manager is more junior than the new tier, so the choice was cleared. Pick someone at this tier or above.
employeeForm.noCandidates: Nobody holds a tier senior enough to manage this person.

tiers.title: Approval tiers
tiers.subtitle: The seniority ranks a request's approval chain is chosen by. Renaming one re-labels every screen that shows it.
tiers.name: Name
tiers.numberHint: 1 is the head of the organisation; a bigger number is a more junior role. The number is what employees and approval chains point at, so it cannot be changed later.
tiers.numberLocked: The number cannot be changed — employees and approval chains point at it.
tiers.nameArHint: Shown to readers using Arabic. Left empty, they see the name above.
tiers.deleteHint: This is refused while any employee or approval chain still uses the tier, and the refusal will name what does.

leaveYear.title: Open leave year
leaveYear.yearLocked: Only the current year can be opened.
leaveYear.explain: Grants every active employee the entitlement from this grid for that year. Last year's unused days are carried over (types with Carry over) or expired (types without). Running twice is safe — already-opened employees are skipped.
leaveYear.nothingToDo: Nothing to do — every employee was already opened for {{year}}.
leaveYear.prorated_one: {{count}} employee was hired part way through the year, so their grant is proportional.
leaveYear.prorated_other: {{count}} employees were hired part way through the year, so their grants are proportional.

leavePolicy.fixedFromTiers: Days come from this type's tiers — fixed entitlement does not apply.
leavePolicy.nameRequired: Give the leave type a name.

leaveBalance.noneForYear: No leave types have a balance for {{year}}.
leaveBalance.yearNotOpened: No leave year opened for {{year}} — open it from Leave policy.
leaveBalance.unavailable: The yearly balance could not be read.

leaveAdjust.title: Adjust leave balance
leaveAdjust.intro: Corrects what this employee's ledger says they are owed. Positive days give leave back, negative days take it away.
leaveAdjust.daysHint: Positive adds days back to the balance, negative removes them. Half days are allowed.
leaveAdjust.noteHint: Why the balance is being changed. The row stays on the ledger permanently, and this note is the only record of the reason — so it is required.
leaveAdjust.effectiveHint: Posted as an Adjustment dated today, {{date}}.
leaveAdjust.leaveTypeRequired: Choose the leave type to adjust.
leaveAdjust.daysRequired: Enter a number of days other than zero.
leaveAdjust.noteRequired: A note is required — it is the reason this adjustment can be explained later.
leaveAdjust.noTypes: No leave types are defined, so there is nothing to adjust.

salaryComponents.tierBand: Tier {{tier}}: basic salary must be between {{min}} and {{max}} {{currency}}

reference.deleteConfirm: This removes it for good. If anything still uses it, the delete is refused and you can deactivate it instead.
reference.deactivateHint: Deactivating keeps the history and takes it out of every pick-list. It can be reactivated later.
reference.deactivated: “{{name}}” deactivated — it no longer appears in pick-lists.

branchHistory.intro: The branch this employee belonged to, and from when. Rosters, attendance and payroll read the branch as of the day they are about. To transfer, edit the employee and change the branch.
branchHistory.cancelBody: The transfer to {{branch}} on {{date}} has not started yet. Cancelling it keeps the employee where they are.
branchHistory.loadFailed: Could not load the branch history.

punchDirection.title: Punch direction
punchDirection.intro: Terminals record whether a punch was a check-in or a check-out from whichever state key was showing — and people do not press it. These settings decide how the system reads that, without ever changing what the machine actually sent.
punchDirection.modeAlternate: Automatic — first punch of the day is In, next is Out (ignores the machine’s In/Out keys)
punchDirection.modeHintAlternate: Directions are worked out from the order of each employee’s punches that day, so the machine’s In/Out key does not matter.
punchDirection.modeHintDevice: Each punch is taken as the machine labelled it. Correct only where staff really do press the state key every time.
punchDirection.debounceHint: A finger held a moment too long registers three times in four seconds. Within this window the repeats count as one press. 0 turns it off.
punchDirection.footnote: Applies when punches are processed. Changing this does not rewrite past days — use Re-process day on the <daily>Daily page</daily> to re-derive a day.
punchDirection.missingMain: Punch interpretation is not configured on the server.
punchDirection.missingBody: The PunchDirection settings are missing from core.SETTING. Run 14_punch_direction.sql, then press Refresh.

notifications.notifyOnRequestClosed: Automatic email when a request ends
notifications.whatsAppEnabled: Also send a WhatsApp message when a request ends

settings.systemDenied: You don't have permission to view or change the system settings — the values that decide what a working day is, and therefore what people are paid. Ask an administrator if one of them needs to change. Your own preferences above are still yours.

booking.noAccess: You do not have access to bookings.

calendar.title: Booking calendar
calendar.subtitle: Every room, hour by hour.
calendar.help: Pick any period. Two days or more gives one column per day, with a colour stripe and a short code saying which room each booking is in; a single day gives one column per room. Click empty time to take a booking, or drag over it to choose a longer one. Hatched time is outside the room's opening hours, and a grey striped card is a staff block — the room is held back and cannot be booked.
calendar.roomsHint: Click a room to hide or show it on the grid.
calendar.noRoomsHint: Add a room, or clear the room filter.
calendar.allHiddenHint: Turn one back on in the room legend above.
calendar.tooLongHint: The calendar draws at most {{max}} days at a time — past that the columns are too thin to read. Shorten the period, or use the list.
calendar.slotHint: Book {{room}} at {{time}} — drag for a longer slot

drawer.title: Booking #{{id}}
drawer.blockHint: A block holds the room back. It has no guest and no payment — remove it to make the time bookable again.
drawer.noMethods: No payment methods are set up.
drawer.cancelHint: The guest is told why, so write something they can read.
drawer.closedHint: This booking is {{status}} and can no longer be changed.
drawer.cancelByStaffHint: We are cancelling on the guest. Everything they paid is due back.
drawer.cancelByGuest: Guest asked us — refund minus deposit
drawer.cancelByGuestHint: The guest changed their mind. The deposit is kept; anything paid above it is due back.
drawer.cancelNoteHint: Kept on the booking and printed on the receipt, so write something the guest can read.
drawer.refundAmountHint: {{due}} still due back to the guest.

new.title: New booking
new.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
new.emailHint: Optional — with an address, the guest is emailed their confirmation.
new.previewHint: An estimate. The price that is stored is the one the server works out when the booking is taken.

block.title: Block room
block.reasonHint: Staff only. It never appears on the public availability calendar.

list.title: All bookings
list.subtitle: Every booking in a period, in one list.
list.help: The same bookings the calendar draws, in a list you can sort, filter and search. Click a row to open it. Staff blocks are not shown here — they have no guest and no money; look for them on the calendar.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.subtitle: The rooms, their opening hours and their add-ons.
rooms.help: Everything a booking is priced and validated against. Changing a rate or an add-on price never moves a booking that has already been taken — the amounts are copied onto it when it is booked.
rooms.manageOnly: Editing rooms needs the ‘manage bookings’ permission.
rooms.emptyHint: Add the first room and it opens 09:00–22:00, seven days a week.
rooms.deactivateWarning_one: This room has {{count}} booking still to come. Making it inactive stops new bookings; it does not cancel that one.
rooms.deactivateWarning_other: This room has {{count}} bookings still to come. Making it inactive stops new bookings; it does not cancel them.
rooms.codeHint: The short name the website uses in a link. It must be unique.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.depositHint: The share taken up front. It is applied when the booking is taken and does not change afterwards.
rooms.errNumber: Price and deposit percent must be valid numbers.
rooms.hoursNullHint: Leave empty to use the system default.
rooms.featuresHint: Shown on the website — e.g. “Whiteboard, 55" screen, coffee”.
rooms.policyHint: The cancellation and deposit terms. Printed as the small print on the receipt.
rooms.hoursSaved: The opening hours have been saved.
rooms.hoursHint: A closed day keeps its times, so re-opening it restores them.
rooms.hoursPartialHint: The week is stored a day at a time, so the days before the one that failed have been saved.
rooms.addonRepriceHint: Re-pricing is safe: the amount was copied onto every booking that took it.
rooms.addonErrPrice: The price must be a valid number.

report.title: Bookings report
report.subtitle: What the rooms did over a period.
report.help: Revenue counts confirmed and completed bookings — what was sold. Collected counts every payment received, including money taken against bookings that were later cancelled. They are different numbers on purpose.
report.printHint: Print just the report — no menus, no buttons.
report.footnote: Revenue counts confirmed and completed bookings. Collected counts all payments received in the period, whatever became of the booking.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.heading: Booking #{{id}}
receipt.notFound: That booking could not be found.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.subtitle: Days that are a holiday for every branch or for one. A holiday is paid and never an absence; leave does not spend a day on it; working it earns the holiday premium.
holidays.created: Holiday recorded. The attendance days it touches were re-derived.
holidays.saved: Holiday saved. The attendance days it touches were re-derived.
holidays.deleted: Holiday removed. The attendance days it touched were re-derived.
holidays.deleteBody: {{name}} on {{date}} ({{branch}}) will no longer be a holiday: the days become ordinary working days again and attendance is re-derived.
holidays.formNote: A month that is already paid cannot take a new holiday — that is a payroll adjustment.

fields.name: Name
fields.branchHint: Every branch also covers branches opened later.
fields.paidHint: Off = nobody is absent, but whoever was rostered to work it loses the day.
